thread:
Iris: Halcyon just sent an RFI + heavy security questionnaire. They want: a capability matrix, POC SOW, pricing for a 30-day pilot (dedicated vs private with on-prem HSM), and an explicit answer on whether we can meet a 25ms p99 gen SLA. They called model pinning + HSM + EU residency out as showstoppers.
Noah: I'll take the capability matrix and SLA language. Priya, can you draft the HSM/KMS integration notes and any caveats for on-prem installs?
Priya: Yep. Quick HSM blurb below and I'll drop KMIP snippets to the drive.
```
HSM/KMS (draft):
- Private: full on-prem HSM via KMIP/PKCS#11. Customer retains key material; Redwood provides integration adapter and KMS proxy.
- Dedicated: BYO HSM supported across peered VPCs; Redwood terminates TLS and orchestrates key references, keys never leave customer HSM.
- Hosted: managed KMS with envelope encryption; HSM-backed keys available as Enterprise option with attestation reports.
- Caveats: on-prem HSM performance depends on network RTT and HSM throughput; recommend local HSM for low-p99 latency.
```
Jamal: POC pricing proposal: two tracks — Eval (2 weeks hosted credits + 48hr dedicated burst) and Pilot (30-day dedicated at prorated reserved rate or Private trial with on-prem HSM consulting fee). I'll sketch numbers after Ops confirms capacity cost.
Theo: For the 25ms p99 ask: realistic only for short sequences on colocated infra. We should call out expected ranges: hosted ~40-90ms, dedicated (same-region) ~20-45ms, private (on-prem) depends on customer's network/HSM. Recommend offering a latency run in the POC to baseline p99 and acceptance criteria.
OpsBot: Uploaded Halcyon_RFI_2026.xlsx and network-checklist.json to Drives -> https://drive.redwood/internal/halcyon/RFI.
Noah: Matrix CSV draft (stub):
```
feature,hosted,dedicated,private
SLA,99.9% standard,99.95% (SLA),Customer-defined (install)
HSM,Managed KMS,BYO HSM,On-prem HSM via KMIP
Model pinning,No,Yes,Yes
p99 latency (typical),~40-90ms,~20-45ms,Depends on infra
Canary/rollouts,Feature flags,Canary + A/B,Customer-controlled
Data residency,Region-based,Region-based,On-prem
```
Iris: POC timeline suggestion (4 weeks): Week 0 agreements + network preflight; Week 1 infra + baseline func tests; Week 2 perf + HSM latency runs (include HSM throughput testing); Week 3 tuning + eval; Week 4 acceptance + handoff + SOW signature.
Priya: Also flag to security team: Halcyon requires FIPS 140-2 HSM attestation and SOC2 Type II evidence. We'll need to surface our attestation docs or partner attestation.
Iris: Good. I'll assemble the RFI pack: capability_matrix.csv, poc_sow.md, security_answers.docx, and an attachment linking to the attestation PDFs. Will upload to the Halcyon drive in ~90 minutes and share with rep. Ping in-thread for edits. :white_check_mark:
